Name: Pokemon Farm Animals
Author: StormDrakon
Description:
[size=6][center][b][color=#ffe599]Pokemon Farm Animals[/color][/b][/center][/size]
[center]﻿[/center][center]Do you love Pokemon? Do you love Stardew?

Then welcome to the Pokemon as Farm Animals mod![/center]

This mod adds more than 20 different pokemon to Stardew Valley as buyable animals from Marnies Ranch. Just click on the icon of the pokemon in the shop to have your own pals running around on your farm! (You may need to cancel and reselect multiple times until you get the pokemon you were looking for).

All pokemon drop custom items known as Essences, there are five different kinds that you can sell on their own or will break down in the Recycling Machine into useable items!




[b]Essences
[/b](Sell for 300g)

Fire > converts to 3 to 4 magma geodes in a Recycling Machine.        
Grass > converts to 3 to 4 oak resin in a Recycling Machine.        
Water > converts to 1 quality sprinkler in a Recycling Machine.
Air > converts to 1 to 2 batteries in a Recycling Machine.
Earth > converts to 3 to 4 iridium ore in a Recycling Machine.

Sprites used were from the Soul Silver game where the pokemon follows after you, a favorite mechanic of mine. I used the sprites posted by Dragoon and modified them so they be animated properly in Stardew.

The pokemon added in this mod are honestly just some of my favorite pokemon, there was no other method to which these ones were chosen. I
don't know if I'll add any more but feel free to comment your favorite pokemon. If the sprites are accessible like ones in Soul Silver then i might add your favorites too!
[center][size=1]Please do not co[/size][size=1]me for me Pokemon company, i just love pokemon and wanted them to run around on my stardew farm.[/size][/center][center]﻿[/center]
